abstract.t: This document registers additional algorithms in the IANA registries defined by [I-D.ietf-cose-cbor-encoded-cert]. It extends the base C509 certificate specification with post-quantum cryptography (PQC) signature and key-encapsulation algorithms including ML-DSA, ML-KEM, stateful hash-based algorithms (HSS/LMS, XMSS, XMSS^MT), and composite algorithms.
